arguments.sql:
SELECT l.RNP, COUNT(*) AS tests, COUNT(p.ID) AS matched_tests, MIN(l."Date") AS first_test, MIN(p.Birthday) AS earliest_birth
FROM Laboratory AS l
LEFT JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.RNP

    CAST(strftime('%Y', l."Date") AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS NUMERIC) >= 64
LIMIT 1
